analysis: The only changed line is a documentation addition at head line 329 of docs/reference/configuration.md (visible only in the patch hunk @@ -326,6 +326,7). It adds a row for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES, an on-by-default switch where 0/false/off/no restores the previous deadline-admission estimators. The row says it is read in provider-swift/.../Performance/Deadline/AdmissionRateEstimators.swift and forwarded to the launchd provider job. No code is in this PR, so none of the claims can be verified. I found no change to any security-relevant control: no change to encryption, attestation, App Attest authorization (A-016, T-053), prefix-cache TTL, HMAC naming or scope (T-041), the coordinator-provider WebSocket (TB-002), or key custody. The variable only tunes admission-time estimators (an availability/performance tunable). Related existing docs on this page are unchanged: the SSD prefix cache table (base lines 505-529), the LaunchAgent passthrough notes and the endpoint-resumption section. One integration question remains: forwarding this variable to the LaunchAgent presumably extends LaunchAgent.passthroughEnvKeys. That source file was not supplied, so I could not check that the allow-list change is bounded to this one name. The variable is only a local operator-controlled env var, and the consumer/forwarding claims are documented but unverified. This is not a finding, and no threat-model update looks necessary for this doc-only change.
